protocol: Every fifth lexicographically sorted selected ID held out from all fitting; initial fixed RF configuration, no hyperparameter search. Unknown one-hot identity ignored; static maps and historical local discharge allowed.
limitations: Local historical discharge is required, so not ungauged-basin forecasting. No held-out threshold estimated and no event classification reported. Basins may be nested and geographically correlated. This is a separate single-model extension, not an ML-versus-DL claim.
